## Checklist

### All submissions
- [ ] `skill.json` (or equivalent metadata file) is present and all required fields are filled in
- [ ] `README.md` is present and clearly describes what the resource is and how to use it
- [ ] `skills/index.json` has been updated with the new entry
- [ ] No PII, secrets, credentials, or copyrighted material is included
- [ ] I have the right to share this under the stated license (CC0-1.0 for community resources)

### Skills specifically
- [ ] `examples.jsonl` is present with **at least 5 examples** (10+ preferred)
- [ ] Every line in `examples.jsonl` is valid JSON with a `conversations` key
- [ ] Examples use real problems — not textbook toy scenarios
- [ ] The `examples` count in `skill.json` matches the actual line count in `examples.jsonl`
- [ ] `eval.jsonl` is included (recommended — at least 3 test cases)

### Source & credit
- [ ] Source URL is provided (tweet, repo, paper, thread, or "original")
- [ ] Author/credit handle is noted in `skill.json` or the README
